sources.citation: Charpentier, Jean-Michel. 1987. La numération au Sud-Malakula (Vanuatu). In Donald C. Laycock & Werner Winter (eds), A World of Language: Papers presented to Professor S.A. Wurm on his 65th birthday, 105-118. Pacific Linguistics C-100. Canberra: Australian National University.
sources.note: No phonology content: the paper is a comparative morphological analysis of the numeral systems of the 19 South Malakula lects (Navwien forms i-ndrax-saxal '6', i-ndrax-ru '7', i-lanavül a-saxal '11'); forms are given in Charpentier's transcription without stress marks; the words accent/ton/syllabe do not occur (scanned fra+eng of pp.105-118 searched and read).
